description: Single-command probes regenerated for M4 along the lines of spike S10 (ADR 0002 'Math coverage'): symbols and operator names (sym-*), one-argument commands and size switches (arg1-*), two-argument commands (arg2-*), environments (env-*) and miscellaneous constructs (misc-*), display mode. math_errors records the coverage of math-core 0.9.0 under the LFM/1 pre-scan. input: {tex, display}; expected: html (the document HTML of $tex$, or $$tex$$ when display is true) and math_errors. Inputs generated by mathml/gen_mathml.py; expected values blessed with LESSDUGIN_BLESS=1 and reviewed. Every html is also checked by the allowlist checker, for sanitiser equality and for unknown math-core style declarations.
